description: This file defines a custom Jekyll plugin tag 'include_example' that processes code snippets from external files, extracts specific code blocks based on labels, syntax highlights them, and generates HTML output with a link to the full example in the Spark repository.

classes.name: Jekyll::IncludeExampleTag
classes.description: A custom Liquid tag class for including and syntax-highlighting code snippets from external files within Jekyll-generated pages.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the tag with markup and tokens.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Processes the code snippet file, extracts labeled code blocks, applies syntax highlighting, and returns HTML.

methods.name: trim_codeblock
methods.description: Removes common leading whitespace from code lines to normalize indentation.

methods.name: select_lines
methods.description: Selects code lines between specific start and end labels, filtering out label lines.
